schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE corsi (
    id INT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    codice TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    titolo TEXT NOT NULL,
    cfu INT NOT NULL CHECK (cfu BETWEEN 1 AND 30),
    anno_corso INT NOT NULL CHECK (anno_corso BETWEEN 1 AND 3),
    prerequisito_id INT REFERENCES corsi(id),
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE esami (
    id INT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    corso_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES corsi(id),
    matricola_studente TEXT NOT NULL,
    data_appello DATE NOT NULL,
    voto INT NOT NULL CHECK (voto BETWEEN 18 AND 30),
    lode BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
